faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in San Carlos?
faq.answer: San Carlos homeowners typically invest $6,500 to $15,000 for a full window replacement project covering 10–15 windows. This well-established Peninsula community — known as the City of Good Living — features attractive 1950s–1960s ranches and two-stories in neighborhoods like Devonshire and White Oaks. Single window installation starts at approximately $570.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in San Carlos?
faq.answer: Yes. San Carlos requires a building permit for window replacements. Our team manages all permit applications with the City of San Carlos Building Division on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in San Carlos?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in San Carlos commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in San Carlos?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most San Carlos replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in San Carlos?
faq.answer: Most San Carlos projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
